title: Import requests
text: A data import accepts one to one hundred finite numeric values. A proposed import requires its owner's explicit approval before a synthetic workflow is created.

title: Task status
text: Task status can be read only by the authenticated task owner. Failed imports may be proposed again as a new action. A retry is never silently executed.

title: Approval boundaries
text: Review the proposed values, then approve that exact proposal ID. Approval is bound to the owner and immutable payload. Repeated approval returns the same workflow receipt.
